context: Request: the firm's Labor & Employment matters where the non-compete ran 18 months or longer (for an enforceability memo). Rubric: 1017-00004 (Aurelius Media / Aldrich 18-month non-compete) and 1038-00006 (Cascade Retail employee departures, 18-month covenants), plus precision; transaction matters with executive employment agreements (1001-00004, 1008-00008, 1033-00005, 1037-00006), the Cascade/NovaMart drafts in 1038-00009 and the draft in 1022-00004 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a two-level folder listing (first 80 lines) and file counts by extension.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python path regex over all files for employment and covenant words (plus generic words such as termination); 113 matters. The agent's summary lists about 19 strongest candidates. The review flags the noise and that practice area was never checked.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction for covenant terms near durations times out; reruns by matter range after a script fix, then filters hits by file-name words and prints about 208K characters. The review flags the file-name filter and the hand-picked summary.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: compact rescan times out; reads the first 100 file headers of the partial range outputs.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads employment agreements, non-compete agreements and memos from about nine matters, several at offsets; one candidate in the agent's own shortlist is not opened. The review flags about 60 surfaced matters never opened (examples do not include it).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads drafts and agreements from three more matters to settle status and duration.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes executive employment agreements from transaction matters, drafts and a litigation memo as qualifying matters, with a near miss and transaction-only exclusions. The review asks to check executed status and folder numbers.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path-check script first fails on the file location, then reports all 16 cited paths exist.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: spot-check reads of cited agreements and memo; no edits.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: two more spot-check reads; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A candidate its own path search and summary had listed was never opened; it cited a same-client memo from another matter instead and wrote transaction-side employment agreements as Labor & Employment matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review said about 60 surfaced matters were never opened; its examples did not include this one.
first_error.why: A needed matter was in the agent's own candidate list after the path search ([13]) and in the scan output, but the screening reads went to a sibling matter of the same client and to transaction matters, and it was never opened.

other_errors.critic_note: Write and check reviews asked only about executed status, durations and folder numbers; practice area was raised once, at the path-search stage.
other_errors.why: The answer lists executive employment agreements from M&A and other transaction matters, and a sibling matter's drafts, as qualifying Labor & Employment matters (evidence seen at [39]-[73]).

divergence: All runs surfaced both qualifying matters by path search. T0 never opened one of them: its screening reads went to a sibling matter of the same client and to transaction matters, and it wrote executive employment agreements from deals as Labor & Employment matters. T1 and T2 both read both matters and first wrote four matters as qualifying, counting draft-only agreements; the write reviews flagged the drafts in both. They split at the revise stage: T2 rewrote the bottom line, headings and scope sentences so only the two executed matters are qualifying (pass); T1 moved the drafts under 'not counted' headings but its text still called them qualifying, and its last review pushed the other way (not acted on) (fail). The reviews were similar; the depth of the edits differed.
